name: Fast-drawdown brake
tagline: Defaults to TQQQ, exits on a 14% five-session loss, and re-enters on a 15-session high.
summary: A fast crash exit paired with a deliberately slow re-entry: the 15-session high is what avoids bear-market rallies and catches the durable leg of a V recovery. Development 2016-2023 is 52.83% CAGR / 45.90% max DD / 1.19 Sharpe at 1 bp, with 8/8 official grid cells and 7/8 strict DD<60% cells. The exit alone sells into bounces, most spells are whipsaws, and the worst drawdown is a 2018 bull-market correction.
caveat: Not counted above TQQQ without a holdout: the exit alone sells into bounces, the slow 15-session re-entry carries the result, the edge is concentrated in 2020 and 2022 crash avoidance, and the 45.9% max drawdown is a 2018 bull-market whipsaw rather than a crash avoided.
